---
title: "Artificial Intelligence"
---

An introduction to the theory and practice of artificial intelligence, covering intelligent agents, search, knowledge representation, and machine learning — with emphasis on how AI systems are designed, built, and evaluated.

## Topics

1. **Intelligent Agents** — agent architectures, environments, and rationality.
2. **Problem Solving & Search** — uninformed and informed search, heuristics, and constraint satisfaction.
3. **Knowledge Representation & Reasoning** — logic, rules, and expert systems.
4. **Uncertainty & Probabilistic Reasoning** — Bayesian inference and decision making.
5. **Machine Learning Foundations** — supervised and unsupervised learning, model evaluation.
6. **AI Applications** — computer vision, NLP, and intelligent systems in practice.

## Learning Outcomes

By the end of the course, students will be able to:

- Describe the core paradigms of AI and identify which technique suits a given problem.
- Implement search and reasoning algorithms in Python.
- Build and evaluate basic machine-learning models.
- Discuss ethical and practical considerations in AI deployment.
